space.name: Kitting Domain Layout 13
space.notes: The meta-planner test-bed's room without the coffee machine (MPB part (v), cell A4, the cause boundary; analysis/mpb/coverage.md, authoring.md part (v)). env_layout_12 with coffee_machine_0 removed and nothing else changed. Created because the mechanism requires the absence of the coffee_break hypothesis: at an episode boundary the belief resets to the prior and the leader is the first live hypothesis in the recognizer's order (by repr), where coffee_break(...) precedes every deliver_item(...); with the machine present the recorded delivery can never remain the leader at a reset. Not because the room is inconvenient (Hadi, 29 September 2026).
